releaseNotes:
Rookline 0.6.16 refreshes Drive, Engineer, Setup, support screens, and the integrated RookForce wheelbase workspace; improves LMU live telemetry and run recording; and keeps cars, seasons, tracks, loaded setups, copied setup files, and recorded sessions correctly matched.

The Windows installers are not Authenticode-signed. Rookline verifies the published combined installer with the SHA-256 value in the HTTPS release manifest before updater launch.
